definition.note: No closed form is stored for this surface. It is defined by its shipped implementation in math_art.minimal_surface_toolkit, which is authoritative; an unverified transcription would silently define a different surface.

provenance.definition: Derived from the Math Art generator registries and cross-referenced to the literature; not transcribed from any gallery's compilation.
sources: A. Enneper (1864); the catenoid (surface of Euler, 1744) was shown minimal by J. B. C. Meusnier (1776).
